calibration.statement: Calibrated strictly by alert frequency budget (median <= 3, p95 <= 8 per stock-month) on historical data. Zero forward-return data was inspected or used in this calibration.

history.outcome: Exceeded frequency budget due to zone-entry firing on intraday wicks and multi-kind emission on same day.

history.rationale: Zone entry restricted to close landing inside the zone (eliminating intraday wick noise). At most one level alert per level per day resolved by strict priority (Break > Zone Enter > Approach), ensuring breaks are never shadowed. Scale-aware 0.5% log grid buckets for swing level keys. Cooldown scoped strictly to KIND_AND_LEVEL for 10 trading days (two calendar trading weeks) so an approach never silences a subsequent break while preventing repeated zone and approach chatter during sideways consolidation. Data-health alerts throttled with 5-day reminder and recovery note.
history.outcome: Budget fully met on shipped TypeScript replay: Median 2.0 <= 3.0, p95 8.0 <= 8.0, Mean 2.84.

levelBreak.breakNote: In our test, breaks reversed more often than they continued

cooldown.rationale: 10 trading days (two calendar trading weeks) scoped strictly per (stock, kind, levelKey). Scoped per kind so an earlier approach or zone alert can never silence a subsequent break, while preventing repeated approach and zone-entry noise during consolidation to satisfy the <= 8.0 p95 monthly budget.

disclaimer: Reference only. Not a forecast. In our test of six rule sets on 433 stocks none showed an edge.
